notes: The two possessives are decided separately: the italic her at t009 is added because טָהֳרָה there is absolute with no suffix (rule 18's closing sentence, corroborated only by the italic under rule 7), while her at t030 answers to the written suffix הּ.

The no of touch no hallowed thing is read as כֹּל fused with לֹא across the intervening noun, since the one English word carries both the negation and the quantification (rules 30, 35); the competing reading giving it to לֹא alone is named in that unit's note under rule 8.

The numeral phrase has one waw between numerals and one English and, which joins three to thirty, so s004 takes it (rule 42); the counted noun is rendered once and tail-to-tail puts it on the last absolute יָמִים, leaving the first יוֹם unrepresented (rule 22).

The בְּ of בְּכָל־קֹדֶשׁ is unrepresented because the ASV promotes its object to a direct object of touch (rule 40), and the waw of וְאֶל־הַמִּקְדָּשׁ לֹא is fused with the following negative into nor across the fronted phrase (rule 35).
